We assessed the quality of various pretraining datasets and the sentences generated by models. Specifically, our evaluation examined if sentences either from the dataset or generated by models introduced facts not included in the corresponding graphs or failed to mention details.

overall_notes: The paper provides a comprehensive evaluation of graph-to-text generation using both automatic metrics and human evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some key datasets and models mentioned in the experimental sections. The paper focuses on evaluating NLG outputs but does not use LLMs as evaluators - LLMs are used for generation tasks only.
